A spirit speaks to me in the night. I hear its words. We have plenty of grain, yes. The stores are full from good harvests past. Wewush are hungry, you say? It is a hard thing to be hungry. But the spirits do not always tell the truth of the world as it is. I must think on this. We have enough, but our fields are not yet showing their strength for this year. Still, we are fair people. If they are truly neighbours, and truly hungry, we shall see what we can do without weakening ourselves.
